scope: Do not create a no-op workspace Undo entry when a user reselects the already active, open dock tab.

implementation.root_cause: The active-tab click handler unconditionally pushed the current workspace snapshot before reapplying the already selected, open dock. This enabled Undo even though neither workspace nor Page Model state changed.
implementation.behavior: The click handler returns before creating history or writing shell state when the selected side is already active and its dock is open. Clicking a different tab, or reopening a closed active dock, still follows the existing workspace history and persistence path.
implementation.data_contracts: Workspace presentation remains local and separate from Page Model, Save, Publish and API writes. Desktop docks continue to reserve a non-overlapped canvas; mobile keeps its single-drawer model.
